project_type: Next.js 15 (App Router) + TypeScript web app (OrientApp), deployed on Vercel with Neon serverless Postgres. Located under web/. Original Android sources under app/ are untouched.
build_system: npm. Scripts in web/package.json: dev, build (next build), start, lint (next lint), typecheck (tsc --noEmit), test (vitest), db:seed (tsx scripts/seed.ts), knowledge:ingest (to be removed). Node is provided via nvm: run `export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 22` before any npm command.
test_framework: Vitest 3. Tests live in web/tests/*.test.ts. Baseline is 155 tests across 14 files, all green. Method-engine tests (engine, chaside-engine, cipr-engine, tipov-engine, magdalena-engine, method-registry) MUST stay intact and green.
build_command: cd web && npm run build (must succeed with NO env vars set: env -u DATABASE_URL -u AUTH_SECRET -u GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID npm run build). All DB/secret/email config must be read lazily at request time.
test_command: cd web && npm run test -- --run   (also: npm run typecheck ; npm run lint)
verification_instructions: From web/: (1) npm run typecheck  (2) npm run lint  (3) npm run test -- --run  (4) no-env build: env -u DATABASE_URL -u AUTH_SECRET -u GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID -u RESEND_API_KEY npm run build . All four must pass. Live DB and live Resend email cannot be exercised in-sandbox (no credentials); rely on unit tests with mocked Resend and lazy-config assertions.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. .next/ is build output (gitignored). No snapshot fixtures.
setup_instructions: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 22; cd web; npm install. node_modules is NOT committed; run npm install first. Network is OPEN_INTERNET so adding bcryptjs and resend via npm install works.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET (npm installs allowed). No live Neon DB and no live Resend key available in-sandbox, so DB seeding and real email sending cannot be executed; must be covered by unit tests (mock Resend, assert SQL/lazy behavior) and the no-env build invariant. bcryptjs is the required hashing lib (pure-JS, serverless-safe on Vercel).
contribution_requirements: Work ONLY on branch feat/web-migration-vercel-neon; commit onto it (extends open PR #1). Do NOT create a new branch, switch branches, or push. Keep ALL user-facing text in SPANISH. Preserve no-env build + lazy config invariant. Never hardcode real secrets except the intentionally-documented default seeded admin password. Passwords always bcrypt-hashed.
key_patterns: Auth.js v5 (next-auth@beta) configured in web/auth.ts via a lazy config function; isAuthConfigured() gates provider registration. Role model in lib/riasec/types.ts (USER_ROLES: SUPER_ADMIN/TEST_ADMIN/REPORT_REVIEWER/STUDENT). Authorization helpers: lib/auth/session.ts (getCurrentUser/requireRole/requireStaff), lib/auth/staff.ts (authorizeStaffWithRoles + legacy STAFF_ACCESS_TOKEN fallback), lib/auth/read-access.ts (authorizeSessionRead). DB access via lazy client lib/db.ts (query, withTransaction). Deterministic method engines in lib/methods/* return {dimensionScores, dominantCodes, dominantSummary, interpretation, raw} from a pure score() fn - this interpretation is already the deterministic report. Sessions persisted in assessment_sessions with student_email used for anonymous group students. Cohorts (=groups) in cohort_groups with code PK + free-text title + method_id; /g/{code} redirects to /assessment?cohort=CODE&method=METHOD; QrCode component + lib/qr.ts build the link. Seed script scripts/seed.ts is idempotent (ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING), reads DATABASE_URL lazily, exits in Spanish if unset.
